title: Artifact Content Schema
description: Meta-schema that defines the structure and validation rules for artifact generation schemas. This schema ensures artifact schemas conform to the required pattern for defining artifact type, output format, data properties, and generation settings.

$schema.description: The schema to verify this document against.

$id.description: A unique identifier for the schema.

$ref.description: A reference to another schema to include.

$comment.description: Comments from schema authors to readers or maintainers of the schema.

description.description: A long description of the schema. Used in hover menus and suggestions.

type.description: Either a string of one of the basic schema types (number, integer, null, array, object, boolean, string) or an array of strings specifying a subset of those types.

properties.description: A map of property names to schemas for each property.
